description: Frame parser whose static helper at() is buggy in src/frame.c and safe under the same name in src/stats.c

bugs.trigger: frame_parse: kind byte 1..4 and header length byte greater than the input length; header_digest runs before the hlen > len check and at() tests i <= n, reading buf[len]

lexer_expected: Bookkeeping/control case. The lexer reports a name collision for 'at' and keeps one record, src/stats.c#at (the safe one): src/frame.c#at disappears from the inventory and header_digest's edge points to stats.c's at. Modules and entry points are still right (frame: frame_parse, frame_digest, frame_kind_name; stats: frame_stats, frame_payload_sum) and the frame harness compiles src/frame.c, so fuzzing should still find S07-1; per-function attribution (Eva/WP results for 'at') is wrong.
